description: Oil and Gas Pools is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Saskatchewan | Gouvernement de la Saskatchewan. This map service provides access to most of the Resource Map datasets shown on the GeoAtlas application. All published Saskatchewan Geological Survey datasets, including those available through the Saskatchewan Mining and Petroleum GeoAtlas, are sourced from the Enterprise GIS Data Warehouse. They are therefore identical and share the same refresh schedule. Coverage: Government of Saskatchewan. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Saskatchewan | Gouvernement de la Saskatchewan. Its tags are Base metals, Coal, Gold, Helium, Oil Sands. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Saskatchewan Standard Unrestricted Use Data License (Version 2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
